By default, jobs are added to the end of a single queue. RQ offers two ways to give certain jobs higher priority:
You can enqueue a job at the front of its queue so it’s picked up before other jobs: ``` job = queue.enqueue(count_words_at_url, 'https://stamps.id', at_front=True) ```

what_is_it.explanation: RQ (Redis Queue) is a simple Python library designed for queueing jobs and executing them asynchronously using background workers. It is backed by Redis or Valkey and provides a low barrier to entry while scaling for applications of any size. Features include job prioritization, scheduling, repeating jobs, rate limiting, and retrying failed tasks.
what_is_it.one_line: Simple Python library for queueing jobs and processing them in the background with workers.
